data.name: Anees
data.gender_notes: Anees is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Anees is an elegant Arabic name meaning 'friendly', 'intimate companion', or 'close friend'. It is often used to describe someone who brings comfort, warmth, and loyalty to others through deep companionship. The name Anees carries the meaning “Friendly, Companion, Intimate” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Arabic. Parents who choose Anees usually hope their child will grow to embody friendly, companion, intimate and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes a soul that soothes others, brings peace, and offers heartfelt companionship — a trusted presence in every journey.
data.etymology: Anees belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Friendly, Companion, Intimate.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Anees total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: عنيس
in_arabic.long_meaning: عنيس هو اسم عربي يرمز إلى الشخص المبارك والمحبوب، ويتكون من الحرف العربي ع - ن - ي - س. في اللغة العربية، يعني اسم عنيس الحب والجمال، ويشير إلى الشخص الذي يتمتع بعدم سلبية الظروف، ويتسم بالحسن المظهر، والجمال الداخلي والخارجي. في اليهودية، يعتبر اسم عنيس اسمًا مقدسًا، حيث يرمز إلى الشخص الذي يتمتع بالحكمة العليا. وفي إسرائيل، يعتبر اسم عنيس واحدًا من أشهر الأسماء في المجتمع اليهودي.

in_urdu.name: عنيس
in_urdu.long_meaning: عنيس نام کا مطلب مرحوم، مقدس، مبارک، محبوب، رفیق ہے۔ یہ نام عربی زبان کا ہے۔ اس کا مطلب ہے کہ جس کا نام عنیس ہو وہ اچھا انسان ہوگا۔ اس کا مطلب یہ بھی ہے کہ وہ اس کی طرف سے محبوب ہوگا۔ اس کا مطلب یہ بھی ہے کہ وہ اس کی طرف سے محتاج ہوگا۔

in_hindi.name: अनीस
in_hindi.long_meaning: अनीस नाम का अर्थ मरहूम, मुकद्दस, मुबारक, मुबाहब, रफ़ीक है। यह नाम अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है। इस नाम का अर्थ है कि जिस का नाम अनीस हो वह अच्छा इंसान होगा। इसका अर्थ यह भी है कि वह उस की तरफ से प्यारा होगा। इसका अर्थ यह भी है कि वह उस की तरफ से मोहब्बत करेगा।

in_pashto.name: انيس
in_pashto.long_meaning: انيس د ځانګړی نوم دی چې د عربي ژبې څخه راغلی دی. دا نوم د عربي ژبې له مخې مرغوم، مقدس، مبارک، محبوب او رفیق ګډون کوي. دا نوم د عربي ژبې له مخې د انسان د طبیعت د ښهاليو څخه راغلی دی. دا نوم د عربي ژبې له مخې د انسان د عقل او ځوابويې څخه راغلی دی.

in_english.name: Anees
in_english.long_meaning: The name Anees is derived from the Arabic root 'n-s', which means to be blessed, beloved, companion, favorite, and pious. In Arabic, the name Anees is a symbol of a person who is blessed and beloved by Allah. It is a name that conveys a sense of closeness to Allah and is often associated with spiritual growth and enlightenment. In Islamic tradition, the name Anees is considered a sacred name and is often given to children born into devout families.

data.cultural_impact: The name Anees holds a significant cultural appeal due to its deep-rooted connotations of friendship and companionship. In Islamic traditions, the concept of friendship is highly valued and emphasized, particularly in the context of the relationship between the believer and Allah (SWT), and between the believer and other believers. This is reflected in numerous hadiths and teachings of the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH), who emphasized the importance of kindness, love, and supporting one another as believers. The name Anees serves as a daily reminder of these values and the importance of building strong relationships and connections with those around us.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Anees holds immense significance as it is a reminder of the close, intimate relationship between the believer and Allah (SWT). The term Awliya Allah (Friends of Allah) is often used to describe those who have a deep, abiding love and connection with Allah, and strive to follow His commands and please Him in all aspects of their lives. By adopting the name Anees, one is consciously reminding oneself of the importance of striving to be a close companion and friend to Allah, and to build a strong, unwavering relationship with Him. Additionally, the name Anees speaks to the concept of companionship beyond the physical realm, emphasizing the importance of spiritual companionship and friendship with those who share similar beliefs and values.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The name Anees translates to 'Helper' or 'Assistant' in Arabic. Spiritually, it signifies being supportive and faithful in one's duties towards Allah and fellow beings. An Anees is someone who strives to alleviate the suffering of others and strengthens the bonds of unity and love within the community.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Anees is mentioned in the book 'Kitab al-Aghani' as a companion of the Prophet Muhammad. The name Anees carried significant weight in that era.
